name: Liliana the Faultless
description: An Echoverse healer from Benalia, a member of the Forward Order, who has lived hundreds of years and assists the Theorist as Professor Opal.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: She belonged to the Forward Order.
relations.quote: belonging to a convocation of clerics known as the Forward Order
